standard-dialogue-after-completing-a-ruf.npc: Thank you once again, adventurer. You've really given us hope to keep going.
Wonderful, because our work has just begun!
Word has spread of our shelter and we've received letters about stray dogs across the world.
Chase has been keeping a log of all the reports. If you speak with him, he'll show you.
Well, you'll be able to adopt any puppies you bring back.

dialogue-if-the-player-is-wearing-cat-ea.npc: I'm sorry, but I refuse to speak with someone wearing such cringe head wear.
